description: This file implements the business logic layer of a shopping cart service, including functions to retrieve, add, update, remove, and clear cart items. It utilizes models and database interactions to manage cart data with validation, error handling, and logging.

classes.name: CartServiceError
classes.description: Base exception class for cart service operations.

classes.name: InvalidCartDataError
classes.description: Exception raised when cart data validation fails.

methods.name: CartResponse get_user_cart(user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a user's cart, creating it if nonexistent, and recalculate totals.

methods.name: CartResponse add_item_to_cart(user_id: str, item_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Add an item to the user's cart or update its quantity, then recalculate totals.

methods.name: CartResponse update_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str, quantity: int)
methods.description: Update the quantity of a specific cart item, ensuring validation and totals update.

methods.name: CartResponse remove_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str)
methods.description: Remove a specific item from the cart with totals recalculation.

methods.name: CartResponse clear_user_cart(user_id: str)
methods.description: Clear all items from the user’s cart, resetting totals to zero.

ctags.name: add_item_to_cart
ctags.pattern: /^async def add_item_to_cart(user_id: str, item_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> CartResponse:$/

ctags.name: remove_cart_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def remove_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str) -> CartResponse:$/

ctags.name: update_cart_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str, quantity: int) -> CartResponse:$/
